params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: "Beheer je voorkeuren" in the footer of the daily bidding mail opens the administrator's garage sheet, which a dealer may not see: 403 "Geen toegang". A dealer who wants to change how often he gets bidding mails cannot get there from the mail.

Source: Portal mail:15 (forwarded by the operator, 2026-10-12). A dealer clicked the link to stop the daily digest and got the 403 page.

**What is wrong.** `resources/views/mails/export_daily_mail.blade.php` builds the footer link as `route('dealer.edit', $dealer_id)`. That route is the administrator's garage sheet (behind the `dealers` menu right); a dealer user is sent to the 403 page by the Access middleware.

**Fix.** Point the link at the dealer's own sheet, `route('ownuser.edit', ...)`, which carries the field "Mail samenvatting biedingswagens per dag" and which every user of that garage may open (`DealerController::authorizeGarage`). Add a test that the link in the daily mail is a page the reader can open.

Related: #997 (an option to receive no bidding mails at all).
params.title: "Beheer je voorkeuren" in the daily bidding mail is a 403 for a dealer
